detail: the property may be absent, and its type also holds `null`; an explicit `null` is written out but read back as `None`, the same as absent. The type is reached from a request body and a response body, so neither a request nor a response read through the generated type can tell an explicit null from an absent member
`maximum`, `minimum` narrow which values are valid in a way no Rust type expresses; the generated type accepts more than the document allows
